title: CeraVe Eye Repair Cream 0.5 oz

comparisons.notes: Same CeraVe Eye Repair Cream 0.5 oz, sold and shipped by Walmart.com at $12.72
Same CeraVe Eye Repair Cream 0.5 oz listed at $14.49

writeup: Woot has CeraVe Eye Repair Cream in the 0.5 oz tube for $6.99. It's the under-eye cream with hyaluronic acid, niacinamide and CeraVe's three ceramides. Walmart sells the same tube for $12.72 and Target for $14.49, so this is about 45% under the cheapest. Woot caps it at 3 per customer.
